name: AGC 111946 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 111946, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc111946-hubble
story: AGC 111946 is one of the lowest-mass gas-rich galaxies that still hold stars. Hubble picked out its individual stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: AGC 111946 is a SHIELD galaxy: an extremely low-mass gas-rich dwarf discovered by the ALFALFA survey
Hubble imaging measured AGC 111946's distance from its red giant stars (TRGB)
